		}
		if = { limit = { country_exists = KOR }
			KOR = {
				set_variable = { mdr_mnc_nokia = 1 }
				add_to_array = { global.mdr_mnc_nokia_h = THIS }
			}
		}
		mdr_mnc_world_monthly = yes
	}
}

mdr_mnc_tick_exxonmobil = {

	set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_hq_ok = 0 }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = USA }
		USA = { save_event_target_as = mdr_mnc_hq }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_hq_ok = 1 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_h
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_lv = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_frz = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_frz }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_nat = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_nat }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_pw = 12.157 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_take = 0.37 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_west = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_hol = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_new } set_temp_variable = { mdr_mnc_hol = 1 } }
		mdr_mnc_host_step = yes
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil = mdr_mnc_lv }
		set_variable = { mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_frz = mdr_mnc_frz }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_left = 1 } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = mdr_mnc_exxonmobil_out days = 1825 value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_mnc_hq_ok = 1 } check_variable = { mdr_mnc_hq_sum > 0 } }
		event_target:mdr_mnc_hq = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mdr_mnc_income_m } } set_variable = { mdr_mnc_income_m = 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_mnc_income_m = mdr_mnc_hq_sum }
		}
	}
}
